title: Bank’s Receipt
name: FY2026 reporting package received.eml
subject: Received: FY2026 financial statements and compliance certificate
body:
Dana,

This confirms that the bank received HANGS General Contracting LP's financial statements for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 and the signed compliance certificate today, October 23, 2026, through our secure upload.

Received on: October 23, 2026
Documents: FY2026 financial statements; FY2026 compliance certificate signed October 22, 2026

As agreed, the attest team is copied and will perform the covenant procedures in the engagement letter.

Rowan Castell
Vice President, Commercial Lending, Ferncastle Bank
